description: Read the text of a Canvas file so you can summarize it, quiz from it or answer questions about it. Read-only. Works with PDF, Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx, including speaker notes), web pages and plain-text files up to 25 MB. Long files come back in parts: call again with next_offset. Scanned PDFs have no text. Get file_id from list_course_files or list_module_items.

file_id.description: File ID (numeric string). Get it from list_course_files, list_my_files or list_group_files.

max_chars.description: Most characters to return in one call. Default 30000, maximum 100000.

offset.description: Character to start from, for reading the next part of a long file. Use next_offset from the previous call. Default 0.

name: read_course_file
title: Read Course File
